desc: The KSG Defender stands out with its compact design, measuring just 26.1 inches in length, ensuring exceptional maneuverability in tight spaces without compromising on power or performance. Its innovative dual-tube design allows shooters to load multiple types of ammunition, offering unmatched versatility for a variety of situations. Equipped with Magpul flip-up sights, the Defender provides adjustable precision targeting, ensuring accuracy with every shot. The 3 inches chamber is capable of accommodating a wide range of 12 Gauge shells, while the cylinder bore choke ensures consistent and reliable shot patterns. Whether for home defense, tactical use or sporting applications, the KSG Defender combines compactness, adaptability and performance in a single, powerful package.
